body: U+0023# Live Mac checks in the Parallels sandbox, 2026-09-28 11:26-11:55U+000AU+000ABuild: plain Release app from aa5bf95 with testkit/patches/macos-plain-build.patch (bundle id dev.satanshumishra.fieldNotes.plain, ad-hoc signed), run from the guest's ~/Applications. A second copy re-signed as dev.satanshumishra.fieldNotes.plainb gave a fresh notification client for the refused case, so no snapshot restore was needed. Guest display switched to 1600x1200 (default 1096x699 cannot hold a 1280x860 window). Evidence: ~/.mitosis/field-notes/testkit/results/macos/sandbox-2026-09-28 (AX dumps, engine logs, notification_log.txt, screenshots r1-r14).U+000AU+000AU+002D 10.45 PASS. PROBE_AX=1, window 1280x860. Settings tree holds every row (sync rows, Daily reminder, Reminder time, Sound effects, Text size Small/Medium/Large, Week starts on, Spell check, Export, Reclaim space, Delete all), before and after scrolling. Month picker tree holds Jan-Dec, Previous year, Next year, Back to this week, Dismiss month picker; AX press on Next year moved to 2027, Dismiss closed it, app stayed up. Zero `Failed to update ui::AXTree` lines in all three engine logs (stderr capture confirmed live).U+000AU+002D 10.46 PASS, all three parts. First launch: `Requesting authorization with options 7` 0.3 s after start, Settings never opened; Allow -> `didGrant: 1` and 7 requests booked. Reminder: quit, set reminder_time in the settings table to 11:38, relaunched without opening Settings; launch cancelled old requests and booked 7 new ones with no second prompt; usernoted delivered and presented req 1001 at 11:38:00.12; Notification Center lists "Field Notes - You haven't written today's field note yet." The banner itself was not caught on screen (two screenshots at +2 s and +7 s show none; the log says presented as banner). Refused: plainb prompt -> Don't Allow -> `allow: NO`; Settings shows "Notifications are off for Field Notes." with Open System Settings, which opens that app's notification page with Allow notifications off.U+000AU+002D 10.48 PASS with a caveat and one new defect. Pinyin - Simplified: `zhongwen` shows marked "zhong wen" in the note editor and Space gives 中文 on every warm run (4 of 4). When the Pinyin engine (SCIM_Extension) is cold, the first keys are committed as plain letters (app: "z洪文", "zho耐高温"); TextEdit loses all eight keys under the same cold start, so this is macOS, not the app. Japanese Romaji: `nihongo` composes 日本語, Space shows candidates, Return commits (warm).U+000AU+002D NEW DEFECT (Japanese, macOS): convert a word (nihongo, Space, Return), switch to another app and back, press Return: the converted word is deleted and only a newline remains. Reproduced 3 of 3. The editor reports the whole converted word as its selection (AXSelectedText = the word) before and after the switch; after the input method commits on deactivation the selection is still over the word, so Return replaces it. TextEdit under the same sequence keeps the word. Not checked: whether this predates the H11 fix.U+000AU+002D Host isolation: listen-only watch on the host ran through the whole session (result reported separately when it ends at ~12:11).U+000AU+002D Also seen: sidebar buttons expose no AXSelected or value on macOS, so the current screen is not exposed to VoiceOver there (10.19 is test-only; not verified with VoiceOver).
